description: This source file defines a static helper class 'PdfSharpCore' for central configuration management within the PDFsharp library, including reset operations for PDF states and font management.

classes.name: PdfSharpCore
classes.description: A helper static class providing methods to reset the PDFsharp environment and font management to initial states.

methods.name: ResetAll
methods.description: Resets PDFsharp to an initial state after assembly load, including capabilities, font settings, and logging.

methods.name: ResetFontManagement
methods.description: Resets only the font management subsystem to an initial state after assembly load.
